column1: # Lens 26 to 75: n, layout, lens slots, depth, lens entries, chain, faint twists, deals kept to pick from.
# Depth climbs from 13 to 36 by level 53, nearly twice the first 25's slope, and holds at 33 to 36: past that a level
# is a grind, not a harder puzzle. From 39 every deal is a chain (one right move a step), lens entries are a quarter of
# the depth or so (a fifth for two lenses deep), a lens of one or two entries netting +3 so some still zoom by two
# steps or three, and faint twists rise, so the last chapters are harder to crack at the same depth. Levels whose hub
# is a lens hold at 29 to 32: past that one proof at par takes the solver over twenty minutes.
